title: MAS-on-the-Fly: In-Context Structural Adaptation of LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2602.13671v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a promising paradigm for complex tasks. However, existing works often rely on manual designs or "one-size-fits-all" automation and lack adaptability after deployment. We study in-context structural adaptation, where structured experience conditions both query-dependent system generation and execution-time reconfiguration without updating LLM parameters. We introduce MASFly, which realizes this adaptation through two complementary mechanisms. First, a retrieval-augmented SOP instantiation mechanism retrieves and adapts successful collaboration patterns to construct a query-specific MAS. Second, an experience-enhanced process supervision mechanism uses a dedicated Watcher agent to monitor execution against prior failure experience and reconfigure the system upon abnormal behavior. translated_title: MAS-on-the-Fly：基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的上下文结构自适应
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）已成为解决复杂任务的一种有前景的范式。然而，现有工作通常依赖人工设计或“一刀切”的自动化方式，且在部署后缺乏适应能力。我们研究了上下文结构自适应问题，即利用结构化经验来同时调节依赖查询的系统生成和执行时的重新配置，而无需更新LLM参数。我们提出了MASFly，通过两种互补机制实现这种自适应。首先，检索增强的SOP实例化机制通过检索并调整成功的协作模式来构建针对特定查询的MAS。其次，经验增强的过程监督机制使用专门的Watcher智能体，根据先前的失败经验监控执行过程，并在出现异常行为时重新配置系统。实验表明，MASFly实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: 提出MASFly框架，通过检索增强的SOP实例化机制和经验增强的过程监督机制，在无需更新LLM参数的情况下实现多智能体系统根据查询动态生成与执行时重构的上下文结构自适应，达到最先进性能。
en_tdlr: MASFly achieves in-context structural adaptation of LLM-based multi-agent systems through retrieval-augmented SOP instantiation and experience-enhanced process supervision, enabling query-specific system generation and execution-time reconfiguration without parameter updates, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
